lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept (same geometry, path ids unchanged so stops/stations stay): T1 runs in the Boulevard reservation from the south sheet edge and turns on the balloon round the circus island (loop r25/28 ≥ 25, ends ±1.8 = trackCentres/2). S1 is a straight double trunk at y 0 from the west sheet edge and turns on an r40 loop over the water. Only change: added order [trunk, loop] to both for N-O1.

Tide's two-way Sky Loop round the district: rejected. On the ring roads each 90° corner at r70 swings about 29 m inside the corner, over built plots (fails S-C1/S-P2). The ring sits 280–340 m from Crown Circus, so it can't make a ≤150 m interchange with T1 at the hub, and it would lose the airport trunk and the West End run. 'Two-way' is already met: the S1 trunk is double.

Tide's 'T1 through the circus': already met by the balloon round the island. Running on up Crown Avenue (open question in the plan) fails. The avenue ends at Crown Road, 40 m short of the sheet edge, and an 18 m avenue has no room for an r25 turning loop (T-L1 with T-C1). Through-running north needs a road to the sheet edge or a turning block.

Tide's T2 Harbour Line on Harbour Road: not proposed this round, because no alignment passes. North end (300,320) is on the sheet edge, but Harbour Road stops at Comet Row (y −720), 60 m short of the south edge. A 24 m road can't hold an r25 loop, and r50 corners onto Comet Row or Market Street cut about 2.6 m past the inner kerb into plots (T-C1).

T2 is worth having. Measured from plot centres, harbour-east (≈285 m from Records stop, ≈278 m from Harbour station) and docks-east (≈293 m) lie outside transit.reach 250. lantern-west is out of reach too (≈289 m from Comet Row stop). Fix, a road edit in my own remit: carry Harbour Road south to the sheet edge (x 300, y −780). Then T2 can be a straight double track (300,320)→(300,−780) with no ends inside the sheet.

With that road edit, T2 would cross S1 at (300,0), about 40 m from Harbour station (≤150 interchange), and reach T1 through S1. If N-C1 means every pair of lines directly (not only a connected network), a T1–T2 pair is ≈300 m apart and fails. Splice to confirm which reading the checker uses.
